name: ambient-generator
description: Procedural ambient/lo-fi music generator driven by time of day, live weather, and interaction activity.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=3001 npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
